messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: runtime-latency-uswest (p99 > 5s) — page INC-2026 fired for service=runtime-gpu-uswest at 1723459999

michael-oncall: Acked. I'm on it. Starting quick triage — checking queues and autoscaler.

tim-eng: seeing huge tokenizer lag on us-west-2. tokenization-worker pods at 100% CPU and queue depth climbing (~3200).

lucy-sre: logs show repeated stalls in tokenizer v1.2.3 after a recent package bump. Sample:```
[2026-04-10T12:06:20Z] tokenizer: process=tokenize request_id=... duration_ms=4210
[2026-04-10T12:06:21Z] tokenizer: backpressure=true queue_len=3187
```

michael-oncall: Thanks — hypothesis: tokenizer regression causing tail latency. Immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to small-2 for latency-sensitive customers 2) scale dedicated-pool-uswest +4 GPUs 3) temporarily increase request timeouts/disable heavy batchers. Doing them in that order.

sara-support: heads-up to support: drafting short customer note for impacted customers (low volume subset seeing timeouts). Will post once we confirm fallbacks. :memo: 

lucy-sre: kicked off scale: autoscaler applied, new nodes provisioning. +4 gpus requested. ETA ~3m. Also spinning up tokenizers with v1.1.9 (previous stable) as a quick rollback alternative.

tim-eng: rolling routing change: adding route override for routes: /v1/generate (latency-critical) -> model=small-2, weight=30%. Patch deployed:```yaml
- route: /v1/generate
  fallback_model: small-2
  weight: 30
```

michael-oncall: Confirmed route override applied. Observability: p99 down from 6.2s -> 3.8s in the last 30s for test traffic. Queue length slowly decreasing.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Reminder: Escalation window in 8m if not acknowledged by second oncall.

michael-oncall: Will stay on page. If scale + rollback don't stabilize in 10m, we'll escalate PD and open triage.

lucy-sre: Node scale completed. New tokenizers on v1.1.9 registered and passing healthchecks. Starting gradual traffic shift to rollbacks for hot path.

tim-eng: after shift, seeing CPU utilization on tokenizers drop from 98% -> 45% and p99 target now ~1.9s for synthetic load. Customer-facing p99 still improving.

sara-support: posted customer note to status page draft: "We are mitigating increased latency in US-WEST; traffic is being routed to fallback models and tokenizer rollbacks are in progress. Some customers may see degraded throughput. We'll update in 30 min." Asking for approval.

michael-oncall: Approved. Post update and tag scale/rollback in the incident ticket INC-2026.

pagerduty: Notification: page INC-2026 acknowledged by michael-oncall at 1723460100.

lucy-sre: handing off to lucy-sre for sustained monitoring and postmortem. Michael will transition to normal rotation in 15m.

michael-oncall: Handoff: root cause likely tokenizer regression v1.2.3 publishing new batching behavior. Mitigations applied: fallback routing, scale up + rollback to v1.1.9. No customer data loss. Customer impact: increased p99 latency and occasional timeouts for a small subset. Ticket INC-2026 created with links to deploy/rollback logs.

lucy-sre: Taking over. Will keep page and run postmortem template. Heading to runbook: /incidents/runtime/tokenizer-regression. Will post timeline and RCA when stabilized. :white_check_mark:
